scope: Every directed public-review endpoint pair, including Buildings 07 and 10. Unknown access remains unknown. Continuous segment checks cover new/changed walking links and links touching new arrivals/native doors; they are not an accessibility-width certification. Ramp surfaces require separate continuous native triangle/seam checks.
